info.title: dabbler-devidp — Loopback dev IdP for Dabbler platform development.
info.description: Loopback dev IdP for Dabbler platform development. Run `dabbler-devidp` to start an OpenIddict-backed OIDC server on localhost:5100 that issues Entra-ID-compatible tokens for local development without a real cloud IdP.

options.name: --help
options.description:
